all.src: Open for a net CREDIT, or a debit no larger than 3% of W1. A credit BWB has no downside risk; a debit BWB does.
Inner long delta 0.30-0.40; body delta 0.20-0.25; outer long delta 0.08-0.12.
Inner long delta 0.30-0.40; body delta 0.20-0.25; outer long delta 0.08-0.12.
Inner long delta 0.30-0.40; body delta 0.20-0.25; outer long delta 0.08-0.12.
Max loss (W2 - W1) x 100 - credit must be <= 1.5% of equity per unit.
All three strikes: OI >= 500, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid).

management.src: Profit target: close at 25-50% of max profit; default trigger is mark >= 0.30 x (W1 x 100 + credit).
Time rule: close at 21 DTE regardless of P/L.
Breach rule: close if the short body delta exceeds 0.40 (price has come to the body too fast, gamma now dominates).

exits.src: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: the 2 short body calls are the exposure. Flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the short body calls are ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before the ex-dividend date if the short body calls are ITM with extrinsic below the declared dividend.
